title: Lambda expression assigned to a variable. Define a function using the "def" keyword instead.
summary: Used when a lambda expression is assigned to variable rather than defining a standard function with the "def" keyword. pylint calls it unnecessary-lambda-assignment.
message_templates: Lambda expression assigned to a variable. Define a function using the "def" keyword instead.

title: Lambda expression called directly. Execute the expression inline instead.
summary: Used when a lambda expression is directly called rather than executing its contents inline. pylint calls it unnecessary-direct-lambda-call.
message_templates: Lambda expression called directly. Execute the expression inline instead.
